title: Compliance Document References
description: AGB-74 slice 3: closed contracts for customer-declared document references about an Agent: a link plus a SHA-256 that the customer states belongs to the document. The platform never fetches, previews, extracts, stores or analyses the document, and never checks that the link serves those bytes: the hash basis is always `customer_declared` and every reference is an `unverified_external_reference`. The URL is CUSTOMER CONTENT: it travels in request and list-response bodies only (never a path or query string), is returned only to project members by the list endpoint, and is absent from the compliance-evidence response, from audit text, from logs and from every error. There is no title, filename, note or supplier field. Records are append-only; a withdrawal is a new row. The actor, time, tenant and project are always server-derived.

DocumentIngredientId.description: A `D` (document) ingredient of the regulation catalogue crosswalk. The Backend validates it against the vendored catalogue.

DocumentKind.description: Closed, derived one-to-one from the `D` ingredient: D1a risk_management_evidence, D1b rights_impact_assessment, D1c risk_assessment, D2 technical_documentation, D3 supplier_due_diligence, D4 cybersecurity_audit_report.

HashBasis.description: Who established the digest. Closed to the only basis there is: the customer declared it. The platform did not read the document.

Verification.description: A reference is never verified: the platform neither fetched the link nor compared the bytes with the digest.

url.description: CUSTOMER CONTENT. https only; credentials in the authority, and query strings or fragments that look like signed-link parameters (X-Amz-*, sig, token, signature, se, sp), are refused, never stripped. Sent in the body only. The Backend never fetches it.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 the customer declares for the document. Stored lower-case.

DocumentReferenceCreateRequest.description: Actor, time, tenant, project, document kind and hash basis are server-derived and are NOT accepted.

DocumentReferenceWithdrawRequest.description: Empty by design: a withdrawal carries no free text.

url.description: CUSTOMER CONTENT. Null on a withdrawal row. Returned only to project members, only by the create response and the list endpoint.

sha256.description: The customer-declared digest. Null on a withdrawal row.

verification.description: Always `unverified_external_reference` on a reference row; null on a withdrawal row.

actor.description: The member who WROTE this row: the declarer on a reference, the withdrawing member on a withdrawal. principal_ref is 'erased' after account erasure; the url and sha256 are kept.

withdrawn_by.description: Computed on read: the id of the withdrawal row that withdrew this reference, if any.

can_withdraw.description: True iff the caller may withdraw this reference now: the member who recorded it, or a project admin; false on a withdrawal row and on a reference that was already withdrawn.

DocumentReferenceSummary.description: The closed summary carried on a `D` ingredient row of the compliance-evidence response: a customer-declared reference exists. It never carries the URL or the digest.
